mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP growth rate above 2% correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns as equity valuations reflect expanding economic output.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or 20d returns in high-GDPC1 growth periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Stable inflation below 238.5 on CPIAUCSL index indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving equity demand and positive SPX returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 238.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals sectoral divergence where housing strength offsets manufacturing weakness, generating positive 20d SPX returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and HOUST > 1200 but SPX 20d returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative SPX returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% but SPX 20d returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signal robust consumer demand, driving positive 60-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 but SPX 60d returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales growth (RSAFS) combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 239) indicates healthy consumer spending, generating positive SPX returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth and CPIAUCSL < 239 but SPX 5d returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 index level during late-cycle economic contraction signals manufacturing weakness, leading to negative SPX returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of instances.
